title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.33 (quiet) at 02:00 UTC on 23 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 23 日 02:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.33 (0P) at 02:00 UTC on 23 September. The 02:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 02:59; hour-start 0.33/0P, hour-end 0.00/0Z). Last-180 maximum is 0.67 (first at 2026-09-23 02:45 UTC; label 1M; last-180 window from 00:00 UTC). Published-window maximum is 0.67 (first at 2026-09-22 23:00 UTC; label 1M). Window start 2026-09-22 21:02 UTC (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (02:00 UTC on 23 September). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 02:00 UTC is 0.33/0P; the hour ends 0.00/0Z at 02:59. A 0.67/1M excursion remains in the published window (first at 2026-09-22 23:00 UTC).

title.en: A magnitude 4.5 earthquake occurred 63 km NE of Ruteng, Indonesia on 23 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 23 日，印尼 Ruteng 東北約 63 公里發生規模 4.5 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 4.5, depth about 10 km. Current day-feed maximum is mww 5.1 (us7000tj4y, 88 km NNW of Uken, Japan).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 4.5，深度約 10 公里。一日饋送目前最大為 mww 5.1（us7000tj4y，日本 Uken 西北偏北約 88 公里）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
